entities.summary: Jean-Claude Schmitt is a prominent French medievalist, the former student of Jacques Le Goff, associated with the work of the Annales School. He studies the socio-cultural aspects of medieval history in Western Europe and has made important contributions in his use of anthropological and art historical methods to interpret history. Jean-Claude Schmitt was a journalists & chroniclers from Colmar (b. 1946-03-04, Colmar). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
